visionAnalysis.title: Vision Analysis Settings
visionAnalysis.description: Control whether the AI analyzes images embedded in your documents. Disabling this can significantly reduce API costs for documents with many images.
visionAnalysis.costWarning: ⚠️ Vision analysis can be expensive for documents with many images. Each image analyzed incurs additional API costs. Consider disabling if you primarily work with text-only documents.
visionAnalysis.feature1: Images in PDFs and DOCX files will be analyzed
visionAnalysis.feature2: Charts, diagrams, and visual content will be extracted
visionAnalysis.feature3: Form fields in images can be detected (FormConnect)
visionAnalysis.disabled1: Only text content will be analyzed (lower cost)
visionAnalysis.disabled2: Visual elements in documents will be ignored

pdfParsing.title: PDF Parsing Preferences
pdfParsing.description: Control how the system processes PDF documents. Choose the mode that best fits your workflow and document types.
pdfParsing.explanation: 💡 Different parsing modes offer different trade-offs between speed and accuracy. Choose based on your typical document types.
pdfParsing.enhancedDescription: Always uses PyMuPDF4LLM for superior table extraction. Best for documents with complex tables, but slower.
pdfParsing.basicDescription: Uses fast pypdf extraction only. Best for text-only documents without tables.

processingDefaults.title: Processing Defaults
processingDefaults.description: Set your default preferences for document processing. These settings will be used by default, but you can override them for individual operations using the gear icon.
processingDefaults.explanation: 💡 These defaults determine how documents are processed across all features. You can override these settings for any specific task using the gear icon next to the processing options.
processingDefaults.vectorSearchDescription: Uses AI similarity search to find relevant content quickly. Best for most use cases.
processingDefaults.fullScanDescription: Analyzes all content in the knowledge base thoroughly. More comprehensive but slower.
processingDefaults.enableVisionAnalysis: Enable vision analysis for images in documents
processingDefaults.visionAnalysisDescription: When enabled, images in PDFs and DOCX files will be analyzed. This can increase API costs significantly for image-heavy documents.
processingDefaults.visionEnabledDescription: Images in PDFs and DOCX files will be analyzed
processingDefaults.visionDisabledDescription: Only text content will be analyzed (lower cost)
processingDefaults.visionCostWarning: ⚠️ Warning: Vision analysis can be expensive for documents with many images. Each image analyzed incurs additional API costs.
processingDefaults.enhancedParsingDescription: Uses PyMuPDF4LLM for superior table extraction. Best for complex documents.
processingDefaults.basicParsingDescription: Uses fast pypdf extraction. Best for text-only documents.

processingSettings.title: Processing Settings
processingSettings.vectorSearchDescription: Fast, targeted results using AI similarity
processingSettings.visionAnalysisDescription: Extract information from charts, diagrams, and images
processingSettings.visionDisabledDescription: Only analyze text content (faster, lower cost)
processingSettings.overrideNote: 💡 These settings will override your default preferences for this operation only.
